# Project Principles

<!-- ew:invariant id="workflow.owner-boundaries" -->
## Source Ownership

Each active invariant has one canonical owner and task routes link that owner.

<!-- ew:invariant id="workflow.efficient-execution" -->
## Efficient Execution

Preserve correctness and required evidence while using bounded inspection.

<!-- ew:invariant id="workflow.evidence-driven-completion" -->
## Evidence-Driven Completion

Use the required checks as green and stop after the result is proven.

<!-- ew:invariant id="workflow.completion-driven-wait" -->
## Completion-Driven Wait

Use completion notifications, durable result artifacts, and bounded summaries for long-running work.
